statement: For a commutative ring A, a ring homomorphism φ:A→A equal to its identity, a scheme T and arbitrary unbounded derived A-module sheaves U,V, let δ be the published scalar tensor comparison and z:Fφ≅id the normalized scalar identity mate [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations, def-weil-pbc-normalized-origin-scalar-comparisons, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-kun-derived-tensor]. Then δ(U,V);(zU⊗zV)=z(U⊗V).

proof.text: After substituting φ=id, the ordinary restriction compositor at id,id is the whiskered ordinary restriction identity, by sectionwise identity maps. Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_id_comp and naturality transport this equality to the derived compositor. Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_comp_id identifies its left mate with the whiskered normalized scalar identity.

proof.text: Apply the tensor composition square at id,id. For any isomorphism z:F≅id, naturality at zW and cancellation show z(FW)=F(zW). Naturality of the tensorator at (zU,zV) rewrites the right side as F(δ(U,V);T(zU,zV));δ(U,V). Cancel the invertible final tensorator and use faithfulness of F, transported from id along z. This is the desired identity square.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarTensor_id
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (φ : A →+* A) (hφ : φ = RingHom.id A)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (U V : DerivedCategoryModule A T) :
    (tensorIso φ T).hom.app (U, V) ≫
      (Functor.uncurry.obj (derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T)).map
        (Prod.mkHom ((ProEtale.normalizedOriginScalarUnit T.smallEtaleTopology φ hφ).hom.app U)
          ((ProEtale.normalizedOriginScalarUnit T.smallEtaleTopology φ hφ).hom.app V)) =
    (ProEtale.normalizedOriginScalarUnit T.smallEtaleTopology φ hφ).hom.app
      (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).obj U).obj V)
